verses.text: Ayik ix lajwi yek'kan juntzanh chi', a winhaj Acab rey t'a Samaria, ix snib'ej winh sman jab' slum jun winh aj Jezreel skuch Nabot. Ha jab' slum winh chi' awab'il te' uwa t'a sat, ha t'a stz'ey spalacio winh rey chi' ay. Ay jun k'uhal ix yal winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Nabot chi' icha tik: --Ak' jab' a lum chi' t'ayin, yik hata' swawej jab'ok witaj, yujto t'a stz'ey in palacio ay. Haxo junokxo lum te wach' swak' sk'exulok, mato tzin tup t'ayach icha stojol, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Nabot chi' icha tik: --Max yal-laj, yujto max yal-laj sk'ol Dios to tzin chonhel in makb'en ak'b'ilkan yuj in mam wicham, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi', ix pax winhaj Acab chi' t'a spalacio. Ix te och pitz'an t'a sk'o'ol winh, ix somchajcha'anh winh yuj tas ix yal winhaj Nabot chi'. Yuj chi' ayik ix k'och winh t'a spalacio chi', ix ek' jichan winh, ix meltzajkanoch k'elan winh t'a yich sch'at, majxo scha walaj sb'a winh.
Ix k'och ix Jezabel, ix yetb'eyum winh t'a stz'ey, ix sk'anb'an ix: --¿Tas yuj schichon a k'o'ol, max yal a k'ol tzach wa'i? xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi winh: --Yujto ix in lolon yet' winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel yuj jab' slu'um winh b'aj ay te' uwa, ix in k'an in man t'a winh, mato swak' junokxo lum sk'exulok, palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix yak' lum t'ayin, yuj chi' schichon in k'o'ol, xchi winh t'a ix.

Ix tak'wi ix t'a winh: --¿Tas yuj stak a k'ol yuj jun chi'? ¿Tom manh sreyalok Israel aj jun? Manh ak' pensar yuj jun chi'. K'e'anh wa'an, wa'anh. Ha in ol wik'ek' jun lum chi', ol wak'an lum t'ayach, xchi ix.

Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'o'an jun ch'anh carta ix t'a sb'i winhaj Acab chi', haxo sello winh ix yak'och ix t'a ch'anh. Ix yak'anb'at ch'anh ix t'a heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' b'aj kajan winhaj Nabot chi'.
Ix yalan ix t'a ch'anh carta chi' icha tik: Tze molb'ej heb' anima yik tz'och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Tzeyak'em k'ojan winhaj Nabot t'a yichanh heb' anima chi' t'a junok lugar niwan yelk'ochi.

Tze sayan chawanhok winak chuk spensar stek'b'ej sb'a yalan t'a spatik winh icha tik: Ha ach tik, ix ach b'uchwaj t'a Dios yet' t'a winh rey, xchiokab' heb' t'a winh. Slajwi chi' tzeyik'anel winh t'a sti'el chonhab', haxo ta' tze julk'enejcham winh, xchib'at ix.
Haxo heb' ichamtak winak chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' icha wal ix aj yalanb'at ix Jezabel chi' t'a ch'anh scarta chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalankot heb' t'a ix Jezabel chi' to toxo ix cham winhaj Nabot chi'.

Ayik ix yab'an ix Jezabel chi', ix yalan ix t'a winhaj Acab chi': --Ha tikne'ik b'at makkan ikok lum slu'um winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel, haton lum maj yal sk'o'ol winh ix schonh t'ayach, yujto toxo ix cham winh, xchi ix.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Acab chi' to toxo ix cham winhaj Nabot chi', ix b'at sb'o'anoch sb'a winh t'a sat lu'um.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a winhaj Elías aj Tisbe:
--Ixik b'at il winhaj Acab sreyal Samaria. Ha t'a Jezreel ayek' winh tikne'ik t'a lum slu'um winhaj Nabot, haton lum ix yik'ek' winh t'a winh.

Tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Yujto ix a milcham winhaj Nabot, ix ik'anek' lum slu'um winh tik, yuj chi' a b'aj ix lek'jik'e schik'il winh yuj nok' tz'i', hanheja' pax ta' ol lek'jokk'e a chik'il a ach tik yuj nok', xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Elías chi'.

Ix yalan winhaj Acab chi' t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik: --Ach ajk'o'ol, ix in ilchaj u'uj, xchi winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Elías chi': --Ach ilchaj toni, yujto ix a tek'b'ej a b'a a k'ulan tas te chuk t'a yichanh Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová: Ol wik'kot kusk'olal t'a ib'anh, ol satel masanil heb' winak t'a inhtilal yet' heb' winak niwak yelk'och t'a skal chonhab' Israel, ma heb' chekab' yaji.

Icha wal wutejnak in satanel heb' yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat yet' heb' yinhtilal winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías, icha wal chi' ol wutej in satanel heb' inhtilal, yujto ix a tzuntzejkot yowal in k'o'ol yuj tas ix a k'ulej, ix a kuchb'anb'at heb' etisraelal t'a chukal, xchi Jehová.
Haxo pax yuj ix Jezabel, a Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha nok' tz'i' ol chi'anb'at schib'ejal ix t'a Jezreel tik.

Ha heb' inhtilal ol cham heb' t'a yol chonhab', a nok' tz'i' ol chi'anb'at sniwanil heb'. Haxo heb' ol cham t'a spatikel chonhab' chi', a nok' ostok ol chi'anb'at heb', xchi Jehová, xchi winhaj Elías chi'.
(Wal yel malaj junokxo rey ix yutej sb'a icha ix yutej sb'a winhaj Acab chi'. Ix kuchb'aj winh yuj ix Jezabel ix yetb'eyum, yik stek'b'an sb'a winh sk'ulan chukal t'a yichanh Jehová.

Te yajb'entak ix yutej sb'a winh ayik ix och winh ejmelal t'a juntzanh komon Dios. Lajan wal ix yutej sb'a winh icha yutejnak sb'a heb' amorreo, haton heb' yik'nakel Jehová t'a yichanh chonhab' Israel.)

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Acab tas ix yal winhaj Elías chi', ix snhik'chitanb'at spichul winh. Ix yak'anoch pichul winh te ya swa'i. Ix och winh t'a tzek'ojk'olal. Ix way winh yet' spichul ya swa chi'. Te kusnak winh tzek' winh.
Yuj chi' ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Elías chi' icha tik:

¿Tzam ila' tas syutej winhaj Acab chi' yik'anem sb'a t'ayin? Yuj chi' manh ol wak'b'at jun yahelal chi' t'a yib'anh winh. Hato yik ayoch junok yuninal winh reyal sk'exulok, hato ta' ol wak'b'ati, xchi t'a winh.
